title: True Girl - The Cat’s Pyjamas Selvedge - Unsanforized
description:
The Cat’s Pyjamas Selvedge is an 8.5oz Japanese selvedge denim inspired by early 20th-century workwear and 1920s reproduction fabrics. The name references period slang, when “the cat’s pyjamas ” was used to describe something exceptional, capturing the spirit of the era this fabric draws from.

Woven with a soft vintage indigo tone and a subtle beige weft, the fabric presents a warm, aged appearance that feels historically grounded rather than modern. A classic white selvedge edge reinforces its traditional construction.

While 8.5oz is considered lightweight today, early 1900s catalogs often marketed 9oz denim as “ultra heavyweight,” making this fabric a faithful interpretation of period-correct denim. Its lighter weight makes it especially suitable for spring and summer while maintaining structure and authenticity.

True to its historical reference, the fabric is finished with a reinforced paper patch rather than leather, reflecting the materials used before leather patches became standard. Tin buttons complete the reproduction-inspired detailing.

Always crafted from Japanese selvedge denim, True Girl has a straight outseam, a flattering high-rise, and timeless straight-leg silhouette.

IMPORTANT — UNSANFORIZED: This garment will shrink approximately two sizes after washing. SIZE UP TWO SIZES. Consult the size chart for pre-wash measurements and the post-wash chart before choosing your size.

8.5oz Japanese Selvedge Denim

100% Cotton

Indigo

Beige weft

Ecru Selvedge Edge

White selvedge edge

Reinforced paper patch

Made in Canada

title: Pullover Hoodie - Double Heavyweight - Navy
description:
The Wonder Looper 876gsm (25.8oz per square yard) Double Heavyweight French Terry Crewneck is made from one of the heaviest knits ever produced with a weight approximately two times that of a standard heavyweight knit. Made in Wakayama Japan on circular knitting machines, this low gauge (10G) French terry has an irregular surface texture with large soft loops on the inside.

The Pullover Hoodie features a modern athletic fit, complete with a drawstring hood and a practical hand warmer pocket. Its raglan sleeves, ribbed side panels, cuffs, and hem offer optimal support and comfort, while the flat seam construction provides a polished finish. Expertly crafted in Japan ensuring superior quality.

title: Zip Hoodie - Iron Mordant FoxFibre®  Double Heavyweight French Terry
description:
The Iron Mordant Foxfibre® Double Heavyweight French Terry - Coyote 80 is one of the heaviest knits available today, boasting an impressive 825 GSM (24.3oz per square yard). Its deep, earthy brown hue isn't the result of traditional dyeing but rather a natural blend of Foxfibre® cotton and an iron mordant treatment, creating a rich, organic tone that deepens over time.

Foxfibre® is a naturally colored cotton, organically gown on a single-origin farm in New Mexico, eliminating the need for artificial dyes.

Our Coyote 80 blend showcases the deepest and richest shades in the FoxFibre® range, blending 80% FoxFibre® with 20% organically grown Extra Long Staple cotton. This combination enhances the material's softness and durability.

To further enrich the fabric's tone, the cotton fibers undergo an iron mordant treatment—a traditional process where fibers are soaked in an iron-rich solution that reacts with the cotton's natural pigments. This process intensifies and darkens the fabric's color, transforming it into a deep, earthy brown with rich dimension and character. Over time, Foxfibre® cotton continues to develop and evolve in color, gradually enhancing its depth for a truly one-of-a-kind aging process.

Produced in Wakayama, Japan, using circular knitting machines, this French terry fabric is characterized by its low gauge (10G) knit, and irregular surface texture that's complemented by large, soft loops on the interior, enhancing both comfort and aesthetic appeal.

Our Zip Hoodie features a modern athletic fit, complete with a drawstring hood, split hand warmer pockets, and raglan sleeves for a comfortable fit.
